system.description: A 2x4m piece of waterproof cloth usable for making shelter.
A collapsible shelter for two people. Larger-size tents are available that accommodate one person per additional +100cr spent.
This tent fits up to 2 people in an air-and-climate-controlled environment. This tent doesn’t have an airlock, so opening it depressurizes the tent and it needs to be repressurized again.
A modular, easy-to-construct planetside habitat that is 6x6m in size. Setting up a pre-fab cabin takes 6 hours.
Similar to a pre-fab cabin but can be pressurized and can recycle air. Ideal for vacuum worlds or planets with minimal or hazardous atmospheres.
